Subject: High latency + 502s in checkout (us-west2)

Vanessa,

We started seeing elevated latency and intermittent 502s hitting our checkout API in us-west2 this morning (around 08:45 PDT). Traffic looks normal but half our checkout requests are timing out or returning 502. Our customers are impacted.

We've already rolled back a couple of recent changes on our end with no improvement. Can you triage urgently and confirm if this is on Redwood's side? We need ETA for mitigation.

Attaching a short capture from our load balancer (sent separately to it-ops).

Thanks,
Tim

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai

On Sat, Jun 26, 2027 at 09:22 AM vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai wrote:
> Tim —
> 
> Thanks for flagging...

Quick notes from triage:
- Symptoms: sudden queue length increase on serving tier in us-west2 starting 08:42 PDT; spike in inference latency and percent 502s correlated with long-latency model loads.
- Initial root cause hypothesis: cache invalidation edge-case for KV prefix when customer traffic includes large numbers of unique conversation prefixes. This caused continuous cold K/V loads and prevented batching from forming (batching starvation).
- Secondary factor: an autothrottle condition in the request router reduced concurrent worker pools under perceived overload, amplifying latency.

Attachments: stargate_error_logs.tar.gz (logs + perf dumps).

Immediate mitigations we pushed at 10:00 PDT:
1) Increased worker pool cap for us-west2 serving nodes (temporary)
2) Tightened KV cache TTL to reduce full-load penalty
3) Enabled a fallback model variant with smaller memory footprint for affected routes

Next: we need a formal RCA and a customer-facing remediation plan. Marcus / Rishi to draft.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: tim.lewis@stargate-retail.com, kelly.donovan@stargate-retail.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 11:38:00 -07:00
Subject: [RCA] Root cause and immediate corrective actions for us-west2 degradation

Tim / Kelly —

Thanks again for your patience. Below is a concise RCA and our commitments. We will follow up with a formal PDF and runbook within 24 hours (attached: stargate_rca_v1.pdf).

Executive summary:
- What happened: On Jun 26 at ~08:42 PDT us-west2 serving nodes experienced a rapid increase in request latency and 502s for Stargate's checkout route. The primary trigger was an edge-case in K/V cache population when traffic has a high cardinality of session prefixes. This created sustained cold loads that prevented batching from forming, leading to high per-token compute and request queueing.
- Why it mattered: Batching starvation + router autothrottle reduced effective concurrency which amplified tail latency into 502s.

Corrective actions (owner / ETA):
- CA1: Fix KV prefix handling to avoid full-key population on high-cardinality prefixes — owner: rishi_malhotra — ETA: 2027-07-08
- CA2: Backfill: Enhance cache warmup and async prefetch for common prefixes — owner: marcus_lin — ETA: 2027-07-04
- CA3: Router tuning: adjust autothrottle thresholds and add hysteresis to avoid over-reduction of worker pools — owner: kimberly_park — ETA: 2027-07-02
- CA4: Customer-side safeguard: provide a recommended route-level fallback config to use the smaller model variant during spikes (documentation + example) — owner: vanessa_ortiz — ETA: 2027-07-01
- CA5: Post-incident load test simulating Stargate traffic patterns and a dedicated mitigation runbook — owner: marcus_lin — ETA: 2027-07-10

Attachments: stargate_rca_v1.pdf, runbook_patch.diff

Temporary measures already applied at 10:00 PDT (Jun 26): increased worker cap, tightened TTL, enabled fallback model variant. These measures reduced 502 rate by ~80% and cut 95p latency from ~2.8s to ~420ms for the affected route.

Commitments to execs:
- Execs from Redwood will join a post-mortem readout on Tue Jun 29 10:00 PDT to review final RCA and sign off on changes.
- Redwood will provide a remediation timeline and weekly status updates until all items are closed.
- We will propose a goodwill credit for June 26 impact; vanessa to coordinate terms with Stargate.

Please confirm next steps that work for you and whether Stargate requires a formal credit request.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Principal Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
